title: [optim][muon] add allow_batched_matrices to Muon for [..., M, N] parameters
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.14.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #190597

* adds an opt-in `allow_batched_matrices` flag to `torch.optim.Muon` for parameters shaped `[..., M, N]`
* why allowing ndim > 2 instead of ndim == 3 exactly: a grouped MoE expert weight is 3D, [num_experts, hidden_dim, dim], and that same weight stacked across layers is 4D, [n_layers, num_experts, hidden_dim, dim]
* fixed a previous bug: `_zeropower_via_newtonschulz` used grad.bfloat16(), which returns grad itself when grad is already bf16, and then normalized it in place via div_. Fixed with grad.to(dtype=torch.bfloat16, copy=True)
